title: VB3-16 interchange: export table row, assertions.jsonl (VB8-04)
description: Mirrors tools/bm_vault_export.py's build_assertions() row exactly (the bundle --vault emitter, not bm_vault_assertions' own record above -- this is the note-provenance table, one row per claim line). Governance columns tenant/authority/lifecycle/sensitivity/evidence_locator are ALWAYS present (never omitted), and the five temporal columns are ALWAYS present but may be the empty string when the note is unmigrated (bm_vault_export._iso_date's own '' default) -- so their pattern allows empty or ISO date, unlike assertion.schema.json's own valid_from/valid_to/etc, which are simply absent when unset. claim_text is deliberately NOT payload-free (it is the note's claim prose, verbatim) -- this table is an outbound artifact by design, restricted notes excluded by default, see the module docstring's RESTRICTED NOTES section. ICEBERG COLUMN MAPPING (the shape contract, no metadata is written): note_id/relpath/content_hash/tenant/authority/lifecycle/sensitivity/evidence_locator/claim_text -> string; valid_from/valid_to/observed_at/ingested_at/verified_at -> string (ISO date or empty; an Iceberg table would carry these as `date`, this shape contract keeps them string until a real writer normalizes empty to null).

evidence_locator.description: opaque to the exporter, any of the seven locator kinds (path/id/commit/url/query_id/document_span/capture)

claim_text.description: verbatim note prose, NOT payload-free by design
